about: THE ONE GLYPH MAP (#1056). It is the only declaration of which glyph each destination and each Engine-page candidate draws, and of where every glyph comes from. The side panel and the engine's templates both read it, and the panel's rail tabs for its own destinations (each <use> carrying data-glyph-destination in extension/app.html) are written from it; nothing else names a destination's glyph. The engine still sends WorkspaceDestination.icon (scrapex/ui_manifest.py), frozen, for panels released before this map; it never follows the map. AUTHORED IN design/glyph-map.json. Every other copy is a GENERATED COPY that tools/sync_design_assets.py writes, beside the engine's sprite and into extension/app.html; never edit one. A key missing from a table draws the fallback, which is null: no glyph at all, a declared absence, so the row keeps its label and no <use> is written for it.
rule: A glyph's id is its source's key under sources, a -, and the name that source publishes, lowercased, with every _ written as -. Material publishes trending_up, so the id is material-trending-up; Material Symbols publishes folder_code, so the id is material-symbols-folder-code; Tabler publishes x-mark, so the id is tabler-x-mark. Every source's ids carry its key, so two sources never share an id. Only sprite ids carry the key: a source's own file keeps the name the source publishes it under (x-mark.svg). Adding a source adds one entry under sources. Changing a source renames its glyphs by this same rule, in the change that swaps their geometry.
